lines.trans: Director Chun!
Just because her voice resembles your ex-girlfriend, you sabotaged her.
You are acting like this just because you are afraid of being associated with the name Luo Lin, right?
Everyone get ready, prepare emergency protocols.
A Fei, go quickly.
Has Luo Lin suffered all these years because of you too?
All our friends in the audience, we are now officially entering the elimination phase.
Now I understand, why I came and why I left.
Following the usual practice of you producers, the truth I just spoke will definitely be cut, right?
It is a pity that your dark history cannot be cut out.
